races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Glenade
runners_data.comment: Second foal; half-brother to 7f 2yo winner Galileo Island; stable in outstanding form
runners_data.spotlight: Kodi Bear colt did well to finish as close as he did given the strong pace he set on debut at Roscommon when third (7.5f, good to yielding); may settle better with that run under his belt and the drop in trip can help too; big chance.

runners_data.name: Kraar
runners_data.spotlight: E6,000 foal and 15,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 1m winner (RPR 64), half-sister to winners Cunning Fox (French/Polish 6f-1m3f) and Investisseur (French 6f-7.5f), out of Group-placed 7f/1m 2yo winner; trainer's other runner looks more appealing at this preliminary stage.

runners_data.name: Hip Hop Chrissy
runners_data.spotlight: 45,000euros yearling; first foal; dam Listed-placed 6f/7f winner (inc AW; RPR 100), half-sister to winners Faraasah (6f) and Felippo (German/French 7f-12.5f), out of unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Muthabara; second of ten in a Naas barrier trial recently.

runners_data.name: Chico Guapo
runners_data.spotlight: Magna Grecia colt; half-brother to winners Paddy's Day (5f/6f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 95), Chica Guerrera (7f 2yo/1m4f; 81) and Shifting Gold (1m-1m4f; 74); dam 6f AW winner (71), half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Duntle; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Shesthedevil
runners_data.comment: Cotai Glory filly; dam 7f winner, hooded for debut, likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly; dam 7f winner (RPR 83), sister to winners Mr Rumbalicious (2m Flat/2m1f hurdle) and Eye For An Eye (Australian 8.5f), out of unraced sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner and Derby runner-up Libertarian; hooded for debut and likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Scarlet Dream
runners_data.spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; dam 1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 96), half-sister to 7f/1m Listed winner Shuwari, out of US 1m1f Grade 3 winner, is granddaughter of 1m1f winning half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Annie Power; finished seventh of ten in a recent barrier trial (behind Hip Hop Chrissy in second).

runners_data.name: Tina Tereshkova
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced dam closely related to winners Tariq (7f Group 2) and Tariq Too (useful 6.5f/7f), out of unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Trimming; unlikely to make immediate impact; hood on for debut.

runners_data.name: Belicoso
runners_data.comment: Churchill colt, dam Listed placed 1m AW winner, yard won this last year, go well
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; finished a short head in front of High Morals on debut at the Curragh (6f, good), but 4.25l behind Ischgl; likely to improve over that first run, but needs to.

runners_data.name: High Morals
runners_data.comment: Highly Motivated colt, dam related to multiple 2yo winners, yard in form, check market
runners_data.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling was sent off the 3-1 favourite for his debut at the Curragh (6f, good) but weakened tamely into eighth (4.25l behind Ischgl); likely capable of better.

runners_data.name: The Drambling Man
runners_data.comment: E7,000 Soldier's Call gelding, half-brother to two 2yo winners, watch unless market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; beaten 8.5l on debut over 5f at Cork on soft, hanging right; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Ischgl
runners_data.comment: Fine run at massive odds here on debut, quicker ground an unknown, could be vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: Belied odds of 100-1 to chase home Ballydoyle hotpot and subsequent Group 3 winner on Curragh debut (6f, soft); confirmed that wasn't a fluke when taking a close fourth back at the Curragh (6f, good) earlier this month; should run his race once again but could be vulnerable to more talented types.

runners_data.name: The Scallionator
runners_data.comment: Shaped with some promise on Naas debut last month; this looks a stronger maiden though
runners_data.spotlight: Improved markedly from debut when stepped up to 6f at Navan and keeping on well for second (good); 7l clear of the rest on that occasion; that run puts him on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: No Time Faults
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 10l on debut at Naas over 5f; a lot of improvement required.

runners_data.name: Portaliffe Phil
runners_data.comment: E35,000 Awtaad colt, half-brother to two 2yo winners, market can guide
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; beat just one rival over 6f at Cork; unlikely.

runners_data.name: Eighteenth Smiles
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; just a respectable fifth of ten at Cork (5f, soft) and filled the same spot at Redcar upped to 6f last time (good); likely to improve over further in the future.

runners_data.name: Ocean Club
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to fire on debut in the Brocklesby at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) and his run at Naas next time was just okay when fourth of seven; upped in trip now but not hugely appealing on form to date.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Citrus Springs
runners_data.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling and 300,000USD at the breeze-ups; seventh foal; half-sister to US winners Spirit Maker (1m-1m1f turf inc 2yo) and Not Guilty (5f AW); dam once-raced half-sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Protonico, is granddaughter of US 8.5f Grade 1 winner Wild Spirit; very interesting debutante.

runners_data.name: Damsel In Distress
runners_data.spotlight: 26,000gns foal and 25,000gns yearling; half-sister to 11.4f winner Schemaya (RPR 83); dam French Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner (91), half-sister to French Group-placed 1m winner Like A Charm and German 7f Listed winner Shehna; market can split trainer's two.

runners_data.name: Exchange Student
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Iko Iko (US stakes-placed 1m turf), Roguery (Australia 1m2f) and Albanian Lady (Australian 6.5f); dam twice-raced half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 1 winner Nereid; check market.

runners_data.name: Madam Secretary
runners_data.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly; sister to 7f 2yo winner Amadeus Mozart (RPR 96); dam once-raced sister to winners Zagitova (Group-placed 1m 2yo) and Frill (7f), half-sister to 6.5f Group 1 winner Garswood, out of unraced close relative of 7f Group 3 winner Infallible; of obvious interest.

runners_data.name: Sister Nancy
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Masar filly; 22,000euros yearling; half-sister to winners La Pasionaria (Listed-placed 1m 2yo; RPR 100) and Artaois (7.5f/1m inc 2yo/Singapore; 84); dam French Listed-placed 8.5f AW winner (91), half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Listed winner Empire Day; hooded for debut.

runners_data.name: Beibhinn
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; weakened into fourth of six in what looks like a strong Naas maiden (6f, good); should improve for that and no surprise to see her in the mix.

runners_data.name: Big Negotiator
runners_data.spotlight: Havana Grey filly was a warm order for her debut at Navan over 5f on yielding when outpaced late on to finish third; improvement likely upped in trip and has race experience; big player.

runners_data.name: Stellar Path
runners_data.comment: Naval Crown filly, dam Italian 9.5f 2yo winner, best watched unless market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: Beat just one rival at Cork on debut over 5f on soft; unlikely.

races.name: Croom House Stud Handicap

runners_data.name: Little Empire
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with consistent form who should get ideal cover in large field and suits the distance
runners_data.comment: Running consistently well on AW this winter; 2-5 on turf and he's on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Admirably consistent on AW and turf; close fourth over 7f at Musselburgh last month and probably best at that trip; stuck out wide, too.

runners_data.name: Unauthorized
runners_data.note: Front-running type who can sit behind Amicitia and benefits from the grade drop after respectable Curragh effort
runners_data.comment: Ended last season with a maiden win at Leopardstown, opening handicap mark seems fair
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner won 7f Leopardstown maiden at two and respectable effort on comeback in 3yo handicap at the Curragh, weakening late over 7f; down in grade and good apprentice on board.

runners_data.name: I Bid You Ajou
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong Fairyhouse hat-trick form who was unlucky in traffic at Naas last time
runners_data.comment: Narrow Leopardstown loss takes him back to career-high mark but capable 7lb claimer booked
runners_data.spotlight: Clicked last summer with a Fairyhouse hat-trick over 6f on nice ground; touched off at Naas two starts back and couldn't get in the clear until too late when beaten just over 2l in premier handicap at the Curragh last weekend.

runners_data.name: Mint Man
runners_data.note: Prominent type with blinkers added first time and back to winnable mark after fair Naas fourth
runners_data.comment: Course form figures of 1-2 at 6f, below best in two runs this term, could revive back here
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 6f at Naas last summer and fair fourth over 5f back there latest; blinkers added and he's back on a winnable mark.

runners_data.name: Apache Outlaw
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with much lower turf mark than AW rating and 58-day break may have freshened him up
runners_data.spotlight: Last win was in late 2024, but was second over 7f at last year's Galway festival and some good AW runs over the winter; has much lower mark on turf.

runners_data.name: Felix Somary
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with concerning finishing kick issues but headgear removal may help over shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Sligo maiden winner, no joy since, dropped 2lb after modest comeback run, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Has been disappointing since debut win over this trip at Sligo, not seeing out his races; drops back in distance and headgear removed.

runners_data.name: Amicitia
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader who gets uncontested lead but 210-day absence is significant concern after tailing off last season
runners_data.spotlight: Prominent racer did well when going handicapping (on straight tracks) last term, placed efforts either side of 5f win at Navan; form tailed off at the back-end; off seven months; poorly drawn.

runners_data.name: Inishfallen
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who has been running consistently without winning but handicapper lowering his mark
runners_data.comment: Beaten less than 1l off this mark last twice on AW, on dangerous turf mark, could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Proving hard to win with; not beaten far last two AW runs, behind I Bid You Ajou when sixth at Naas last time; handicapper starting to play ball.

runners_data.name: Mickey The Steel
runners_data.note: First reserve prominent runner who loves soft ground but 42-day break may not be enough preparation
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; five-time winner loves the mud and solid placed form over 6f/7f early in the season; has had a break since unplaced run at the Curragh.

runners_data.name: Mercurial
runners_data.note: Prominent type with poor recent strike rate but Heffernan booking suggests connections expect improvement
runners_data.comment: Only two wins from 40 starts, placed 16 times, has a preference for soft/heavy
runners_data.spotlight: Over two years since latest of only two wins; second over 6f at the Curragh in October and ran well over 7.5f on return, but poor strike-rate overall; prefers it soft but handles good.

runners_data.name: Dragon Of Malta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is course specialist with two wins here last September but poor recent comeback
runners_data.comment: Tended to need his comeback run so probably best watched here on ground on the quick side
runners_data.spotlight: Course specialist won on successive days at last September's festival (7f/1m on heavy); well beaten on return; opposable at present.

runners_data.name: Aurora Nova
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare whose three wins last term were all over 5f so this trip may stretch her stamina
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D winner on good but the ground might be against her on this occasion
runners_data.spotlight: Made the breakthrough over 6f, but her three wins last term were all over 5f, two of them at Bellewstown where she had a good comeback run in April.

runners_data.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners_data.note: Prominent type who missed break badly last time at Navan which compromised his chance completely
runners_data.comment: Best run for current yard on latest at Dundalk (6f), 5lb higher on turf but could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f maiden for Ballydoyle last summer; best AW run came in March when beaten less than a length in third over 6f; missed break when well-held fourth at Navan last time.

runners_data.name: Altimara
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose back-to-back 7f wins suggest this 6½f trip looks too sharp for optimal performance
runners_data.comment: Back-to-back 7f wins last August, lacks a recent run, might need this
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back 7f wins at Leopardstown in August and placed twice over 1m subsequently; this trip looks too sharp.

runners_data.name: Famed Again
runners_data.note: Second reserve hold-up maiden who showed fair 7f form at two but little progress for current yard
runners_data.comment: Fair form at two, regressive last year, handicap debut, mark is 9lb below initial rating
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden had fair 7f form at two for Tom Cooper but not much yet for current yard, including when mid-field over 7.5f on Roscommon return.

runners_data.name: Ribble Emperor
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was outclassed in AW maiden Tuesday but his mark probably still too high
runners_data.comment: Has placed form here but he's now 0-8 and exposed; unlikely to be winning this
runners_data.spotlight: Can lead and some fair placed form in non-handicaps over 7f/1m, including when outclassed in third behind easy winner in AW maiden on Tuesday; mark probably stiff enough.

races.paceDynamic: Amicitia is the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner field and should get an uncontested lead with sustainable fractions. The prominent group of I Bid You Ajou, Mint Man, Mercurial, Dragon Of Malta, Alfred Tennyson and Ribble Emperor will track behind without applying early pressure. With multiple hold-up horses including Little Empire, Unauthorized, Apache Outlaw, Inishfallen, Aurora Nova and Altimara likely to get cover in this large field, the race sets up as a tactical affair that will favour the patient hold-up performers who can benefit from the strong pace and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a strong gallop and Amicitia sets sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get perfect cover and can unleash late kicks, with Little Empire and Unauthorized best positioned to exploit their preferred running styles. Apache Outlaw and Inishfallen also benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If I Bid You Ajou and Mint Man can track Amicitia in good positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: The mid-division runners avoid traffic problems and can strike in the final furlong when the leaders tire and hold-up horses meet interference. I Bid You Ajou's class and Mint Man's headgear change prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse favours leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Amicitia gets too easy a lead and the field fails to close strongly enough
scenarios.body: The early leaders have too much left in the tank, with Amicitia potentially lasting home and any prominent runners who stayed close benefiting from the lack of strong finishing pace. Dragon Of Malta's course form becomes relevant.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying power at premium
scenarios.trigger: If the yielding ground and 6½f distance favours horses with stamina reserves
scenarios.body: Altimara's 7f form and Famed Again's longer distance background become assets, though both face challenges with the trip potentially being too sharp for optimal performance. The race becomes a test of stamina over speed.

watchPoints.text: Amicitia must handle 210-day layoff after form tailing off badly in final runs last season
Little Empire and Unauthorized could clash for the same hold-up position if the pace becomes too strong early
I Bid You Ajou needs clear run in final furlong after meeting traffic problems when touched off at Naas
Dragon Of Malta's course form is excellent but his poor comeback run raises fitness concerns
Alfred Tennyson must improve significantly from his gate work after missing break badly at Navan

races.name: Coco At The Arcade Race

runners_data.name: Tim Toe
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should get ideal position tracking the pace setters.
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who added a 1m3f maiden at Bellewstown last month; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner and fair maiden hurdler; won Bellewstown maiden over 1m3f; third in slowly-run 1m6f heat at Killarney and opening mark likely flatters him; surely beatable over this trip.

runners_data.name: Straight Up
runners_data.note: High-class prominent runner returning to scene of debut win with strong form figures despite recent defeats.
runners_data.spotlight: Back at the scene of his debut win over 7f (heavy); only beat one home in a Newmarket Group 3 next time but got his healthy mark from that; well beaten both starts this term, too keen the first day and never involved when fitted with a hood in Leopardstown Derby Trial, albeit not beaten that far.

runners_data.name: Satoyama
runners_data.note: Front runner who readily won at Gowran when allowed to dictate, looks progressive type.
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced at two; prominent throughout when readily beating a subsequent winner at Gowran (1m, good to yielding); looks a nice prospect.

runners_data.name: Listentodwindblow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 64-day break but has shown high-class form in valuable contests.
runners_data.comment: First time in a maiden for this 95-rated colt, holds an obvious chance, tongue-tie on
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden was rated 89 after his first three runs, including two in valuable restricted contests; despite being well beaten in 1m1f Group 3 at Leopardstown, was raised to 95; beaten favourite in testing-ground 7f maiden in March and gelded since; good chance at the weights, but unconvincing profile.

runners_data.name: God Of Power
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who will contest the lead but may find this company too strong.
runners_data.spotlight: Handed mark of 80 after 7f maiden win at Limerick; open to improvement but stiff task here.

runners_data.name: Thread Of Gold
runners_data.note: Prominent runner having first run for new connections after 225-day layoff, market will tell story.
runners_data.spotlight: Bought by current owners after debut win at the Curragh (7f, good), the form of which is fairly solid; down the field in 1m1f Group 3 next time; market support would be reassuring.

runners_data.name: Sursum Corda
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who gets significant weight allowance but needs strong pace to be effective.
runners_data.comment: Two fair runs, possibly capable of winning races but may need her sights lowered
runners_data.spotlight: Has kept good company in three starts (7f/1m) and initial mark looks fair, but that leaves her with a bit to find in this company, albeit the weight she gets would account for most of that on paper.

races.paceDynamic: God Of Power and Satoyama are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. With both having shown speed and willingness to lead, they'll set a solid pace that prevents this becoming a sprint finish. The moderate early pace will suit the prominent runners like Tim Toe, Straight Up, and Listentodwindblow who can track the leaders without getting into trouble. This pace dynamic clearly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace and have tactical speed to respond when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If God Of Power and Satoyama set honest fractions without going too fast early.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes perfect for horses tracking just behind who can quicken off that rhythm. Tim Toe, Straight Up, and Listentodwindblow are ideally positioned to strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead or breaks clear early.
scenarios.body: Satoyama or God Of Power steal a march and the prominent runners can't peg them back. The honest pace plays into their stamina reserves rather than exposing their limitations.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong between God Of Power and Satoyama.
scenarios.body: The front runners cook each other and the race falls apart for something coming from behind. Sursum Corda gets the perfect setup with her hold-up style to pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too conservatively or one drops out early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair turning into a sprint finish where class and turn of foot matter most. The higher-rated horses with tactical speed can capitalize on the lack of early tempo.

watchPoints.text: God Of Power and Satoyama clash early could set up perfect pace for prominent runners tracking behind.
Thread Of Gold showing market support after long absence would indicate fitness despite the layoff.
Straight Up getting prominent position early crucial given his need to avoid getting buried in small field.
Sursum Corda requiring strong tempo to show her best but only hold-up horse in field.
Tim Toe and Listentodwindblow both from O'Brien yards could work tactically if positioned together.

races.name: James Collins Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: James Henry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 380-day layoff under in-form Gavin Ryan, better on good ground
runners_data.spotlight: Better AW performer; improved for better ground when a never-nearer third of 19 in an apprentice handicap at Leopardstown (1m, good) when last seen around this time last year; best watched on return/stable debut.

runners_data.name: Rough Diamond
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran carrying bottom weight but poor recent form suggests best days behind him
runners_data.comment: Operating at much lower level now but not showing much for latest trainer; blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Smart handicapper back in the day for Eddie Lynam; wasn't able to add to his tally of five wins when moving to Britain; operating at a much lower level nowadays, but not showing much for present trainer.

runners_data.name: Zabriskie Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse prone to fading in finish, 13 days since last run keeps him sharp
runners_data.comment: Profited from a drop in grade when third at Leopardstown on his penultimate start
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came as a juvenile for Charlie Hills at 5f/7f on different ground types; has plunged in the ratings and took third (0.5l behind Exceeding) at Leopardstown (7f, yielding to soft) in April; unplaced favourite at Gowran next time, but took the runner-up spot at Roscommon (7.5f, good to yielding); in the mix.

runners_data.name: Secret Magician
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed improvement on good ground last time at Killarney when third
runners_data.comment: Exposed; has been struggling in the mud; better can be expected on this surface
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 3-51; improved upon poor recent efforts when encountering good ground at Killarney (1m), finishing a close third after not getting a clear run; up 2lb but remains on a nice mark if backing up his last run.

runners_data.name: Linger For Longer
runners_data.note: Sole front runner gives tactical advantage but poor 2023 form raises questions about ability
runners_data.comment: Three-time winner was below par last year; attractive mark if returning to form
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner was below par last year and didn't provide much encouragement on her return at Limerick.

runners_data.name: Methgal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good current form with recent Dundalk win and two seconds following
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; made the breakthrough in a 7f Dundalk handicap in March and followed that with runner-up finishes over the same trip back at Dundalk and on turf at Leopardstown (yielding to soft); below his best at the Curragh last time.

runners_data.name: Rockbury Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with Colin Keane's big-race experience, third reserve but 16 days since disappointing run
runners_data.comment: Placed twice at Dundalk during the winter, confidence dented by 2-28 record on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; won off 6lb higher at Bellewstown last year (1m, good); latest run at Leopardstown was not encouraging.

runners_data.name: Exceeding
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trained by jockey Andrew Slattery, won last start and raised only 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: Beat Methgal by a short head at Leopardstown (7f, yielding to soft) to gain his second win from 29 starts; raised a fair 3lb for that but overall form suggests he's not certain to back it up.

runners_data.name: Ukiyo
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has decent form over 6f, apprentice jockey takes off 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 6f at Cork on yielding for Gavin Cromwell last year off 50; had Exceeding far behind when runner-up at Navan in March (6f, heavy); didn't back that up at Sligo; tongue tie goes on now.

runners_data.name: Run Forrest Run
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 165-day break for new trainer, best watched on debut
runners_data.comment: No win since October 2024, off since December, watch on debut for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Knows how to win (6-44 on turf) but losing run stretches back to October 2024; in poor form on AW when last seen in December; best watched on debut for new yard after break.

runners_data.name: The Blue Panther
runners_data.note: Prominent runner prone to fading, 52 days since last run may need this outing
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; fair fifth at Leopardstown after slow break last time; goes well fresh
runners_data.spotlight: Added his fifth career win with a heavy-ground C&D success in September off 6lb lower; a lot of improvement needed based on his return at Gowran in April.

runners_data.name: Crackles
runners_data.note: Hold-up juvenile stepping up in distance, poor form for previous trainers continues
runners_data.spotlight: Not much to shout about in form for previous trainers; tailed off on handicap debut at Navan (1m2f, yielding) and not much better in a Gowran maiden (1m2f, heavy); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Toy Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing improved form last time when fourth, second reserve with attractive mark
runners_data.comment: Won a maiden and a claimer in Britain; no worthwhile form in seven runs for current yard
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; won a maiden and a claimer in Britain; poor form for new yard until 2l fourth of 15 at Killarney last time; attractive mark if back in form.

runners_data.name: Sovereign Banter
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from Andrew Slattery stable, 7lb apprentice jockey reduces weight significantly
runners_data.comment: Third behind Winemaker here in January; stable in great form; can make his presence felt
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for trainer; gained his first win at Dundalk in October (6f); made the frame back at Dundalk multiple times afterwards, including when runner-up last month; gelded since then; has run well in defeat on turf in the past; usually ridden by today's rider.

runners_data.name: Liamo
runners_data.note: Prominent type defending crown from 7lb higher mark, 223 days since last flat run
runners_data.comment: Consistent Flat horse at a modest level but completely tailed off on hurdle debut at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 1-20 with the sole victory coming in this race last year on good ground off 7lb lower; consistent form on Flat over the autumn but his most recent maiden hurdle runs at huge odds were woeful; not discounted back on the level and his win came following a similar break.

runners_data.name: La La Lucrative
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare prone to fading, returning after 177-day absence from Matthew Smith
runners_data.spotlight: A winner over 6f on heavy ground in Britain and took a Roscommon handicap off 10lb higher in May last year (7.5f, good); moderate form shown on AW when last seen in December.

runners_data.name: Fleetfootsoldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making stable debut, poor turf record of 1-12 suggests limited ability
runners_data.spotlight: 1-12 on turf (4-18 on AW); makes stable debut following moderate run in a Dundalk claimer in February; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Notforalongtime
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran better on all-weather, recent turf form suggests outclassed at this level
runners_data.spotlight: 9-32 at Dundalk, but just 1-28 on turf; followed up a third-place finish at Cork (1m, good to yielding) by filling the same spot at the Curragh (7f, good), hampered before running on late; on a nice mark if putting it all together.

races.paceDynamic: Linger For Longer is the lone confirmed early pace with most others preferring to hold up, creating a tactical advantage for the leader in this 18-runner handicap. With James Henry and The Blue Panther likely to press forward prominently, but no sustained pressure expected on the front runner, Linger For Longer should dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The large field of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in the straight as they all seek racing room simultaneously. This pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Linger For Longer gets an uncontested lead and comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: The mare can kick clear before the field gets organized, while prominent racers like James Henry and The Blue Panther can track into contention without getting caught in traffic. The hold-up brigade arrives too late after being shuffled back in the large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If James Henry or The Blue Panther can position perfectly behind Linger For Longer
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses are still finding daylight, with Colin Keane's experience on Rockbury Lad potentially navigating through. The pace collapses just enough to bring these trackers into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably slow and the field compacts turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up merchants get their perfect scenario with plenty of pace to aim at late. Exceeding and Secret Magician benefit from their recent form improvement in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems severely hamper the fancied runners in a rough-run race
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner like Toy Soldier or Ukiyo benefits from a clean passage while others get shuffled back. The race turns into a lottery with hold-up horses blocking each other's runs.

watchPoints.text: Linger For Longer gets soft early fractions and kicks clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized
Traffic problems developing turning for home as 15+ hold-up horses seek racing room simultaneously
James Henry's fitness after 380-day absence, any signs of rustiness in preliminaries or early stages
The Blue Panther and other faders getting too prominent too early given their finishing limitations
Ground conditions firming up from current yielding, favoring horses with good ground form

races.name: Lane Family Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Ballyadam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching from hurdles with solid Cheltenham form but faces tough task conceding weight to younger rivals
runners_data.comment: High-class hurdler, placed on Dundalk AW penultimate; ground no problem, tight track query
runners_data.spotlight: Good quality NH performer, including when good fourth in BetMGM Handicap Hurdle at Cheltenham; took the runner-up spot in a Ballinrobe maiden (1m5f, good to yielding) last time when 7l behind the winner; must carry top weight for Flat handicap debut but big chance.

runners_data.name: Loyal Touch
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but 58-day break and poor recent hurdles form raises fitness concerns under claiming rider
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain; not at same level for new yard; well beaten over hurdles in his last two runs.

runners_data.name: Tassarolo
runners_data.note: Prominent style with encouraging Leopardstown return just 2 days ago, though 2m trip remains unproven for this former hurdler
runners_data.comment: Recent Flat return encouraging although remains unproven over this extended trip
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins last year, two over hurdles and 1m4f Killarney Flat handicap off 59; recent Flat return was encouraging at Leopardstown although remains unproven over this extended trip; declared for 7.25 at Down Royal on Friday.

runners_data.name: Lagoon Nebula
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse perfectly suited to this pace setup but 50-day absence and 5lb claimer raises execution questions
runners_data.comment: Stayed on to some effect in a Flat handicap at Bellewstown last month, ground should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Some good runs in defeat at up to 2m last season; moderate efforts over obstacles were punctuated by an okay fifth of 12 at Bellewstown (1m4f, soft) in April; tailed off at Downpatrick over hurdles last time; cheekpieces go on.

runners_data.name: Eben Zaabeel
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with new tongue-tie seeking first Irish success after consistent British AW form for previous yard
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden in Britain for Charlie Hills, runner-up in AW handicaps final two starts in 2024; yet to match that form in Ireland; the tongue tie is new.

runners_data.name: Miss Gitana
runners_data.note: Prominent early but notable for fading in finish, making this extended trip a significant stamina test
runners_data.comment: Down the field on stable debut in the Navan race in which Celtic Druid was fourth
runners_data.spotlight: Three Flat wins, twice in Britain and over this trip at Tramore last July for Gordon Elliott; poor in two runs for new yard; tongue tie goes on but others preferred.

runners_data.name: Sonic Invader
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who appreciated step up to 1m6f last time and looks ideally suited to this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Was entitled to need the run at Navan after a year-long absence, should be sharper now
runners_data.spotlight: Appreciated the step up to 1m6f at Gowran (good to yielding) for his second handicap start when keeping on for third; likely to be suited by this trip on that evidence and Keane remains aboard; big player.

runners_data.name: Parish Express
runners_data.note: Front-running style gets perfect setup but steering issues last time and weak recent form raises reliability concerns
runners_data.comment: Second reserve, weak form in maidens, in rear in a Roscommon handicap after steering issue
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; in rear in a Roscommon handicap last week after steering issue that saw her hang to the left off the bend with a circuit to go; senior rider takes over now.

runners_data.name: Baila Conmigo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 46-day break with solid recent AW form at similar trips
runners_data.comment: Progressing well on AW with two recent wins; tailed off back on turf last time
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winner on the AW at 10.5f-1m4f in February/March; put a poor Bellewstown run behind him when taking the runner-up spot at Leopardstown (1m1f, yielding to soft) last time; unproven at this trip.

runners_data.name: Edge Of Darkness
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendencies racing outside handicap proper on rapidly declining mark
runners_data.comment: 4-time 1m4f winner in Britain; nothing like that sort of form of late; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner over 1m4f back in the day in Britain; nothing like that sort of form for current yard, mark rapidly descending of late but 5lb outside the handicap here; declared reserve in 7.25 at Down Royal on Friday.

runners_data.name: Desert Friend
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran coming off impressive Sligo win where he benefitted from truly-run race at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran has done a bit of everything and recorded his ninth win when easily scoring over 1m6f at Sligo last time (yielding to soft), benefitting from a truly-run race; up 8lb but in the mix.

runners_data.name: All In Peder
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 1032-day absence having won this very race off 2lb lower mark in 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back Flat winner in 2023, including this race off 2lb lower on good; tailed off over hurdles when last seen over a year ago.

runners_data.name: Cala Gracioneta
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with fading tendencies trying 2m for first time after 128-day break and new hood application
runners_data.comment: Poor form form in AW handicaps over the winter; hooded now for turf return

runners_data.name: Mystic Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with unencouraging overall form trying 2m for first time with pedigree offering little stamina hope
runners_data.comment: Maiden has another run under her belt since finishing behind Bhean Saibhre at Navan
runners_data.spotlight: Overall form not encouraging; didn't back up okay Bellewstown fourth at Gowran when well beaten; tries this new trip and pedigree doesn't provide too much hope.

races.paceDynamic: Parish Express is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner field, giving her the chance to dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With most runners holding prominent or hold-up styles, the early pace will be moderate before gradually building through the middle stages. The large field and 2m trip on yielding ground will create a tactical test where position and timing matter crucially. This setup clearly favours hold-up horses who can get a perfect trip in the pack before unleashing late, as Parish Express is unlikely to kick hard enough early to string out the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express sets steady fractions without early pressure and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows hold-up specialists to get ideal positioning before the race develops into a sprint finish where class and tactical speed decide. Horses like Lagoon Nebula, Sonic Invader and Desert Friend can time their runs perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens earlier than expected with multiple horses tracking Parish Express closely
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field more than usual, allowing well-positioned prominent runners to gain first run on the leaders while hold-up horses get caught too far back. Tassarolo and Ballyadam can capitalise from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Parish Express Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear with stamina reserves intact
scenarios.body: Her front-running style pays dividends when allowed to control every sectional, building an unassailable lead that the closers cannot peg back in time. The yielding ground aids her staying power over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express stops or the early pace becomes crawling slow with no horse willing to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the final 3f where early position matters less than raw finishing speed. This chaos scenario can throw up any result from horses with tactical pace regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Parish Express must handle steering issues that caused her to hang left with a circuit to go at Roscommon last time
All In Peder returning from 1032-day layoff despite winning this race previously - fitness will be crucial after such an absence
Desert Friend relying on another truly-run race after scoring easily at Sligo when the pace collapsed in his favour
Multiple horses carry 5lb and 7lb claiming riders including Lagoon Nebula and Edge Of Darkness in large competitive field
Tassarolo running just 2 days after Leopardstown effort - quick turnaround could impact performance levels

races.name: Acro Fire & Safety (Q.R.) Race

runners_data.name: Chain Of Destiny

runners_data.comment: One piece of form came in a maiden; returning from a mammoth absence
runners_data.spotlight: Modest performer and only making up the numbers here.

races.paceDynamic: Quinta Do Lago sits as the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely setting a steady rhythm without pressure from behind. The prominent runners Ndaawi and The Mediator may track close but neither appears aggressive enough to challenge for the early lead. With multiple hold-up horses including Sky Captain, Act Of God, Talking Tough and Chain Of Destiny settling at the rear, this creates a classic scenario where the pace will be controlled and sustainable. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick from close range, as the soft tempo will make it difficult for hold-up horses to close ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Benefits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Quinta Do Lago maintains an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The young hurdler can dictate terms without pressure and prove hard to pass when the field closes late. His recent Punchestown festival form gives him a clear class edge over this field when allowed to control the tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Ndaawi or The Mediator press Quinta Do Lago from halfway
scenarios.body: The dual-purpose experience of these seasoned campaigners allows them to time their challenge perfectly against the younger leader. Elliott's stable form with Ndaawi's Galway Hurdle credentials makes him particularly dangerous tracking a steady pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Home
scenarios.trigger: If Sky Captain produces his best finishing kick from the rear
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced improving sort can benefit from race fitness and Twomey's excellent strike rate to close strongly. His recent course form and visor addition suggest he's primed for a bold show from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Quinta Do Lago fails to handle the ground or distance
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where experience matters most and any of the seasoned performers can capitalize. The Mediator's recent amateur rider success shows he retains ability when things fall his way.

watchPoints.text: Quinta Do Lago's jumping under pressure - any mistakes could hand initiative to prominent trackers Ndaawi or The Mediator
Sky Captain's visor debut combined with Twomey's strong stable form - could signal significant improvement from this hold-up horse
The pace through the early stages - if Quinta Do Lago goes too fast it opens the door for closers
Ndaawi's fitness after 100-day break - Elliott's horses can be spot-on first time back but the layoff is notable
The ground conditions affecting the leaders - any further softening could play into the hands of the hold-up horses
